lines.en: With the looming threat of another beach trip suddenly on the horizon for your hero (me), I have been kidnapped by a rich girl so that she can model swimsuits just to not buy any of them despite all of the money she has.

This part has already happened, though. So you unfortunately don’t get to experience everything I just did, which may or may not also include ejaculating so deeply inside of her that I think I may have fertilized her heart.

Now, if anyone else would like to step forward and allow me to have sex with them in the dressing room of this store, please do so. For I believe I may have unintentionally started another collection just now.
: Well, that was fun.
: You never intended to actually buy a new swimsuit today, did you?
: Sometimes, a girl just needs a little mild exhibitionism to get back on track. And what better place for such a thing than a dressing room at the local mall?
: A parade.
: I said “mild” exhibitionism. I’m not ready for an entire parade to hear me getting pounded by my future husband yet.
: I’m surprised you’re ready for any amount of people hearing you at all when getting caught by a single classmate traumatized you so badly.
: Hey, I was still new to sex when Kirin decided to violate us. I’m such a pro now that, if it happened today, I’d probably only cry a little bit.
: Well, that’s good. Because chances are, it will eventually happen again. And also, Kirin is here right now.
: Mhm. Sure she is. Try to distract me all you want, Akira. I’m still going to ask you why the girls working here said “not again” the second we walked into the sex closet together.
: It’s still a dressing room even if I have only ever used it for sex. Also, I’m not lying. Look.
: Fine. Where is- oh. Yup. That’s her. I can see the desire to wreck various homes from all the way over here.
: She looks sad.
: Good.
: Let’s go talk to her.

: No. In fact, let’s go back inside the sex closet right now. Before your desire to please every cute teenage girl in the world compels you to force me into an awkward situation instead of just up against a wall.
: Hi, Kirin. How can I make your life worse today?
: Oh, come on! She’d find us anyway if you didn’t go walking up to her and at least then I’d have a penis inside of me to numb the pain!
: Oh. Uhh...hey. What are...you guys doing here?
: “Shopping.”
: Why did you say it like that?
: Because we weren’t actually shopping. We were exercising our insatiable love for one another in the same dressing room you’re about to go be a lonely whore in.
: And “hello” to you too, Ayane. I like your outfit.
: Don’t be nice to me. It makes it harder to hate you.
: Are you looking for a new swimsuit too? I don’t normally see you out by yourself these days.
: You don’t normally see me at all these days...and yeah. I’ve had the old one for a while, so...I thought maybe buying something might make me feel a little better.
: What happened?
: Don’t fall for her tricks. She’s only pretending to have feelings so you’ll take her into the sex closet next.
: Ayane, relax. She hasn’t even-
: No, it’s fine. I...get it.
: I’d...never forgive someone either if they...did what I did to you guys. She can insult me all she wants and that’s...I get it.
: I really just...get it.
: Why not come hang out with us?
: What?...
: Yeah. What?
: What? She pretty clearly doesn’t want to be alone right now. Just look at the way she’s timidly holding her arm and looking up at me with puppy dog eyes.
: I don’t care how cute she looks. She sexually assaulted me and never even showed any remorse until I threatened to beat her to a pulp after school one day.
: Sorry, you did what?
: Nothing. I’m the good one.
: Ayane’s right, Sensei. It’s definitely...weird to invite me along when you guys are out on a date and stuff...
: I’ll just...find another store and...grab something, then go home. Thanks, though.
: There! Done and dusted. I’m glad we were able to reach a resolution everyone is okay with.
: How about lunch?
: Darling, are you perhaps confusing me with one of the other six hundred girls you are sleeping with? Because it seems to me like you suddenly think I have a humiliation kink or something!
: I...really shouldn’t if Ayane is so opposed. I don’t want to intrude.
: Again, stop being nice. I know you’re only doing it to sabotage my date.
: I’m literally trying to leave and he won’t let me.
: Walk. You have legs. And this may come as a surprise, but they are good for more than just spreading.
: Despite how rare it is and how attractive I find this abrasive side of Ayane, I can’t help but feel like inviting Kirin along is still the right thing to do.

: Now you’re confusing me too! Peppering things I don’t want to hear with things I do want to hear is like putting rainbow sprinkles on mashed potatoes! You can’t trick me into thinking it’s ice cream!
: It’s just for a little while, Ayane. Do this and I’ll say yes to everything for the rest of the day.
: E...Everything?
: I should go.
: Wait. There’s a real chance I may be able to stop hating you for thirty minutes.
: No, really. I...I mean, I feel kind of weird right now anyway. You’re enjoying yourselves on your day off and I was just...an unfortunate coincidence you encountered along the way.
: Every day is my day off. I’m a professional slacker who mooches off the system and has somehow, almost miraculously, not been caught yet.
: I meant Ayane. I already knew that about you. And...yeah. It would be nice to...have something to do today. But without her blessing, I-
: Oh my f- fine. You can have lunch with us. But only because I want to do some really weird stuff with Sensei and you look legitimately pathetic right now.
: You really do. And, unlike Ayane, I mean that in the least mean way possible.
: Do I...really look that bad? I actually felt kind of cute today...

: It’s a vibe thing, right? Like, aesthetically, you look the same as always. But it’s like the rabid cat living inside of you has turned into a frightened rabbit for reasons I can only assume are stupid and immature in nature.
: I agree that it’s a “vibe thing.” And if something’s wrong, Kirin, you can tell us.
: No, she can tell you. In private. When I am no longer around. The last thing I want is to feel bad for this human.
: I’m really lonely.
: Oh, great. Here we go.

: And it’s all my fault...All this time, I’ve been pretending to be something I’m not. Chasing after some elusive form of self-actualization by degrading myself so brutally and repeatedly. It’s as if I’m caught in a cycle of-
: No one cares! Let’s get lunch!
: Come on, future husband! And you too, future dog! A new restaurant just opened up on the second floor!
: Sorry about her. A lot has changed since you two stopped talking.
: I mean, it’s not like it isn’t my fault.
: Which is...I mean, pretty much everything that’s happened to me is my fault. But even so, I can’t...help but be sad about it. Why am I sad about it? Why do I have so many feelings now?
: Well, you’re in love with someone now. That changes things.
: Wha...pshssshhh...abaaha...Ayane’s right there!
: And you’re right here. With me. Which is exactly where you want to be. So why pretend you should be going somewhere else right now?
: Because that’s all I ever do! I haven’t figured out how to be someone worth loving yet!
: I’d say look at Ayane and get some pointers from her, but she is particularly spicy today.
: What the heck does she even want to do with you that convinced her it’s okay to bring me along?!
: To be honest, I don’t know. And the only reason I do not look terrified right now is because I’m an expert at hiding my emotions.
: Ahem! Akira? Actual teenage girl over here. Don’t you want to give into temptation and follow me?
: Sensei...I...
: Something happened during...Christmallowen that I...
: I can’t...I don’t...I-
: Hi, security? That girl over there is harassing my husband and I’d like to file a complaint.
: Hold that thought, Kirin. I need to go tell someone else I’m not married to a teenager today.
Ayane settles down after a few more minutes and goes back to normal...ish.

I guess it’s more just resigning herself to the fact that Kirin is present rather than actually accepting her, though. Which is probably what she does in school as well, just I’m never around to actually see it anymore.
: Say aaaaaaahh...Akiraaaaa...aaaaaaaahhh...my twenty four hours of yeses begins noooow........
Kirin, on the other hand, could not be any more different from normal if she tried. But that’s why I felt so inclined to call out to her in the first place, even knowing it would upset Ayane.
Which I guess might be the wrong move from a moral standpoint. I mean, I’m sure if you explained this exchange to someone on paper that I’d look like a real asshole right now.
But despite her mistakes and despite what she’s done, I can’t help but look at Kirin like a real person with real feelings rather than a monster.
If only mirrors felt the same.
Maybe it’s just projection. Maybe it’s love. Maybe I do want to drag her into a dressing room next? Whatever it is, I don’t think it really matters.
All that happened was I saw someone who didn’t want to be alone and invited them along, regardless of the consequences that doing such a thing may bring.
It is this exact recklessness that has created the world I’ve made for myself. And I’m sure that Kirin’s would look similar right now if I could only see the world through her eyes.
I don’t think I’d want to, though.
I don’t think this would be easy.
In fact, I think the sight before her right now isn’t all that dissimilar from a failed attempt at arson.
She tried to burn this down once. Or at least that’s how that looks on paper too. Until that paper bursts into flames, at least.
It was never an appetite for destruction that compelled her to “attack” us on the beach so long ago, though.
And I imagine, in hindsight, that if I were to pin her down in that moment and tell her she is loved, she’d be someone completely different from who she wound up as today.
My life is full of small regrets like that. So is hers. And there are so many things the two of us would change if we only had foresight. But a great deal of what life is is accepting you don’t.
And that, sometimes, you are going to make decisions that make every subsequent decision ten times harder.

Then one day, you’ll be at a clothing store somewhere, staring at someone you care about who hasn’t responded to any of your messages today, wondering where you went wrong. Then having too many failures to choose from in actually wondering that.
This is something I haven’t felt myself because I am lucky.
Not everyone is, though. And I often try to remember that in between unwanted blessings.
But I often fail.
As it turns out, blessings are more appealing than regrets, even when undeserved. And that I’d rather live a life of lies than one where I must face the facts I have written myself.
If life is what you make it, just make it better. Lock the sad parts away.
Just accept that, in doing so, there will be moments where they attempt to break free and send your life spiraling into a colossal tempest of unrealized ambition and mind-shattering anguish.
So it goes, I guess.
: So, out of the three swimsuits I actually tried on today before we got distracted, which one was your favorite?
: I don’t remember any of them, to be completely honest. I knew they were only a front.
: You like my regular one too much for me to buy a new one anyway.
: Oh! That reminds me, though. You remember Geoffrey, obviously. Well, apparently, he designed that entire line of swimwear. And he did it while blindfolded by the Spetsnaz. Crazy, right?
: So he’s a fashion designer too, now?
: Not anymore. He did all of that under duress and has sworn off the craft since then.
: I think I could get him to go back into it if I wanted to. I just don’t want to bring back any bad memories, you know?
: Like, I’d have to be a real jerk to intentionally go out of my way and do something like that when everything was fine and normal a second ago. Wouldn’t you agree?
: Is this you subtly voicing your displeasure with me for inviting Kirin again?
: Well, it’s not so subtle anymore now, is it?
: Heh...hahah...
: What? What are you laughing at?
: Just...you guys.
: You look so good together...
: Like you’re really made for each other. It’s sweet.
: Great job, Ayane. Your constant passive-aggressiveness has made her look even more sad.
: No it hasn’t. Those are tears of joy.

: She’s accepted that no amount of meddling in our affairs can ever destroy us and, in a moment similar to what happens in “How the Grinch Stole Christmas,” her heart has grown three sizes and finally brought her bliss.
: Or, alternatively, you are right. And that my attitude has reinforced her belief that she is nothing more than a third wheel today and that we’d be just fine without her here. If not better.
: Again, you’re not wrong.
: And again, I would like you to stop agreeing with me.
: Stop being so perfect all the time and I won’t have to.
: Do you really think that complimenting me and going along with everything I say is going to make me look at you as anything more than a parasite? Because it won’t.
: Ayane, stop. She gets it.
: No, I don’t get it. Keep going. Tear me apart.
: Strangle me again if you have to. Let’s hear it, Ayane. All of it.
: Yeah, you’d like that wouldn’t you? What a foreign sensation it must be — having someone touch you of their own free will instead of you quite literally forcing their hand.
: Mhm...Everything I do is to just...force myself into somewhere I’ve never belonged. You’re so right.
: Is that sarcasm?
: No. You’re right. You’re literally right. No one in their right mind would ever pick me over someone like you.

: So pretty. And kind. To most people at least. Loyal. That ability to switch between mature and quirky whenever you want. Your body. Your sense of humor. You don’t have a single fucking flaw, do you?

: You and Karin both. Noriko too. Like fucking every single person I know is better than me at literally everything and so I went after the most perfect one of all to try and feel better about myself. I’m sorry.
: You’re not sorry. You’re just upset that you can’t leech your way to the top.
: No, I’m sorry. I’m really fucking sorry. I admire you so much...and I really hope you two are happy together one day.
: You’re going to be a great mom, Ayane. I just know it.
: Way better than mine. Way better than yours.
: Better than anyone’s. And your kids are going to grow up to change the world and mine are just...hah, who am I kidding? I’ll never be a mom. No one’s going to have kids with me!

: No one’s ever going to want me! Not for long at least! I’m just a quick fix you can drag into a fucking bathroom to have your way with and then never think about again! I’ll never be a princess! But you will!
: You’ll be anything and everything you want to be...and I am so...so sorry...for wanting a taste of that.
: Kirin.
: No, not just wanting it! I grabbed the whole fucking spoon and shoved it all down my throat because it was the only way I’d ever know what it’s like to be anywhere close to you!
: I’m sorry...I’m sorry! And I know don’t deserve your forgiveness, but I want it! Just...don’t give it to me! I don’t want to be responsible for devaluing you any more than I already have!
: Kirin, what are-
: Please...never forgive me!

: I don’t deserve to sit at the same table or breathe the same air or even walk on the same floor as you! I am a waste of a child and a waste of a friend and a waste of a person who is not fit to love or be loved!

: I’m sorry Sensei invited me along and I’m sorry I came and I’m sorry I’m only making your day worse by being here but I don’t know what I’m doing and I’m just so sorry, Ayane! I’m so sorry! I don’t know what else to say!
: Uhh...okay. You don’t have to say anything. But you definitely don’t have to dogeza either, so-

: OF COURSE I FUCKING DO! Just because I don’t want your forgiveness doesn’t mean I don’t want to ask for it! The least you can know is how fucking sorry I am since I’ve never properly gotten it across!
: And even now, begging on the floor like this is merely a fraction of what you deserve! I just don’t know what else I can do without a fucking wakizashi!
: New idea! Let’s just calm down and not bring seppuku into the equation? Sound good?!
: No! No, Ayane! It doesn’t fucking sound good! I’d rather die and have you know I’m sorry than live with you thinking I am proud of myself for what I did to you when I’m not!
: It haunts me every night now! Just thinking about it makes me want to puke! And all those things I said and did after only made it worse!
: You can kill me yourself if it makes you happy! Just make sure I’m fucking dead because I’m an idiot who’s probably going to make the same mistakes again and ruin someone else’s life next!
: I might hate you, but I don’t actually want you to die! Nor do I think you should!
: Then how the fuck am I supposed to repent?! What can I do to make myself feel like I deserve to be here?! What did you do after I ruined your life?!
: How are you still so confident?! Why are you not broken?!
: Kirin, for the love of God, if you don’t want me to hate you any more, you will stop making a scene right now. This is only making things worse.
: Everything I do makes everything worse, Ayane...
: How can I be someone like you?...
: How can I stop always doing the opposite of what I want?
: How do you do it?...How are you so fucking amazing?
: Kirin, I’m not.
: And the way I’ve been treating you today despite knowing you were going through something like this is all the proof you need of that.
: No one is perfect. No one is as amazing as you think I am. And the advice I have here is going to sound harsh, but it’s the only advice I have when it comes to things like this.
: If you want to stop doing the opposite of what you really want, then just fucking stop.
: I don’t know why you make things harder for yourself. I assumed you just got a rise out of it. But if you hate it so much, stop.
: That’s it. That’s all I have. I’m just a girl like you. I’m not an angel.
: What if I can’t, though?...
: I’ve been trying to be good...but no one thinks I can. So I stop trying at all...
: I don’t know what else is left for me...I don’t know where to go from here.
: Then start from phase one and pick yourself up off of the floor. Okay? Neither one of us belongs down here.
: How can you say that about me?...After all I’ve done?
: Because no one belongs down here. That’s how.
: I’m so sorry, Ayane. I will do anything to show you. Anything.
: Then just eat your fucking parfait and smile like a normal girl. Okay?
: I’m not really hungry, but okay. If that’s what you want...
: Sensei-
: My lips are sealed and I am fully prepared to never again acknowledge anything that has happened over the last five minutes.
: Thank you.
: I’m sorry...really...
: Things lately are just...
: Don’t worry about it. Just...here. Parfait. Eat.
: Mmh...
The three of us have a great time and no one has any sort of mental breakdown at all.
Kirin leaves early and Ayane and I decide to head out shortly after.
My relationship with each of them slightly improves.
Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!
Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!
